title: New Lead → AI Personalized Follow-Up → Google Sheets

sections.label: 1 · CAPTURE THE LEAD
sections.note: Works from a form submission or a new row in your sheet, whichever you already use. Details are cleaned once here, so a messy submission does not become a messy message later.

sections.label: 2 · AI WRITES THE MESSAGE
sections.note: The model is a swappable piece, so Claude or ChatGPT is a one-node change rather than a rebuild. Output is forced into a fixed structure instead of free text, which is what stops the occasional reply that starts with Sure, here's a follow-up message.

sections.label: 3 · CHECK BEFORE IT GOES OUT
sections.note: One quick check catches the two failures that actually happen in production: an empty or truncated response, and a message still carrying a placeholder like [Company]. Anything that fails gets one stricter retry rather than being sent.

sections.label: 4 · SAVE AND SEND
sections.note: The message is written back to the same row so you can read every one before it goes anywhere. Sending is a separate step you can switch on once you trust the output.

input_sample.name: marcus  DELGADO
input_sample.message: Saw you at the trade show. We're opening a second location in Tacoma in the spring and our front desk can't keep up with callbacks as it is.

output_sample.follow_up_message: Hi Marcus — congrats on the Tacoma location. With a second site opening in spring, the callback backlog you mentioned usually gets worse before it gets better, so it's a good moment to look at it. Free for 15 minutes this week?
output_sample.quality_check: passed — no placeholders, no preamble, under 60 words
